Your armband is on Haaland despite the knock flag: he projects 0.3 clear of Salah and has a 75% chance of playing. The risk is real—if he doesn't start, Salah becomes captain by default—but the expected points favour keeping it. If Haaland is ruled out before the deadline, switch to Salah without hesitation.

The one transfer lined up, Wood to Watkins, gains 6.4 points across the horizon with no hit. That's a clear upgrade and worth doing.

Your shape is 3-4-3 with three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. The bench is thin; Mykolenko at 3.1 is your only meaningful cover, and Anderson, Muniz and Pope sit well below. You've little flexibility if anyone else picks up a flag before gameweek end.

The eleven projects to 60.8 points before the armband. You have one free transfer, half a million in the bank, and no immediate pressure to move beyond Watkins.

Your armband is on Haaland at 8.2, a tight 0.3 clear of Salah. The concern is the knock flag: he has a 75% chance of playing, which leaves real uncertainty. If he misses, you drop to 60.8 and lose the captain premium. Salah at 7.9 is the natural fallback and removes that risk entirely, though it costs you those 0.3 points in expectation when Haaland plays.

The suggested transfer is Wood to Watkins, netting 6.4 points over the horizon with no hit. That's a clean gain and worth doing if you're comfortable with it, though it uses your only free transfer.

Your team is well-stocked with Arsenal and Manchester City attackers—three from Arsenal, two from each of Liverpool and City. The bench is thin; Mykolenko at 3.1 is your only meaningful cover if Haaland doesn't play and you've captained him. If you're nervous about the flag, shifting the armband to Salah costs little and buys you peace of mind.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland armband, but he carries a knock with only a 75% chance of playing. Salah is a close alternative at 7.9—just 0.3 behind—and has no injury flag, so you're protected either way. The gap between them is small enough that your armband choice hinges entirely on Haaland's fitness, which remains uncertain.

The proposed transfer of Wood to Watkins nets 6.4 points over the horizon with no hit cost, so it's a clear upgrade. Your bench is thin, with Mykolenko your only meaningful cover at 3.1, but that's a problem you'd solve only if forced by injury or non-appearance.

Your outfield balance is sound at 3-4-3. You do have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City, which concentrates your risk, but all three clubs project strongly and the overlap isn't extreme.

The core decision is Haaland's fitness. If you're confident he'll play, keep the armband. If not, switch to Salah before the deadline and proceed with the Watkins transfer. Given only a quarter chance he doesn't play at all, and the minimal upside of moving the armband, you're not in a bad position either way.
